companion.prompt:
Use case: compositing / product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic illustration for the installation-and-connection task card on a residential home-network service website, one 16:9 landscape image.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the real Schneider Sedna double RJ45 wall socket product photograph. Input image 2 is ONLY a lighting, realistic-material and neutral pale-room style reference, not equipment to reproduce.
Primary request: transform the isolated product photo into a believable close-up in an ordinary modern home: this double RJ45 socket correctly installed on a pale neutral wall WITH its matching simple white outer decorative frame, no exposed metal mounting frame. A single human hand is connecting a blue Ethernet patch cable to one of the two black RJ45 sockets. Show a physically correct transparent RJ45 plug with normal eight contacts, a blue strain-relief boot, correct alignment and latch, just entering one socket. The second socket remains empty and clearly visible. Cable is one continuous cable and falls naturally down and out of frame. Keep the genuine two-port geometry from image 1.
Composition: close crop, socket and connector large, immediately understandable at 400px image width; slight three-quarter angle, socket on the left half and hand entering from the right, natural home daylight. Crop arm naturally out of frame, ordinary neat hand with anatomically correct fingers, no face or person. White wall, very subtle warm neutral background; believable understated service illustration with real plastic, skin and cable textures.
Constraints: no router, phone, desktop PC, rack, tester, electrical mains outlets, tools, exposed wires or damaged insulation. No logos, labels, legible text, captions, watermark, collage or website interface. No imaginary cable junctions, no branched plugs, no impossible socket connections. Illustrative scene, not a claimed documentary client visit. One complete landscape photo.
